Render the generated bindings for a set of exported functions

Source: R/render.R
render_bindings.Rd

Produces the three texts that document() writes into a package, without writing anything: the Zig manifest that registers the exported functions, the R wrappers that call them, and the NAMESPACE block that resolves the native symbols. Use the function to inspect what document() will generate.

Usage

render_bindings(
  exports,
  package = attr(exports, "package", exact = TRUE),
  roxygen = FALSE
)

Arguments

exports

An object returned by scan_exports().

package

The package name; by default taken from exports.

roxygen

Render for a package whose NAMESPACE roxygen2 generates: the wrappers then carry the useDynLib directive as a @rawNamespace tag, and namespace holds the lines roxygen2 writes for them.

Value

An object of class rzig_bindings: a list with the character strings manifest (src/rzig/framework/generated/manifest.zig), wrappers (R/rzig-wrappers.R) and namespace (the generated NAMESPACE block, or with roxygen = TRUE the NAMESPACE lines that roxygen2 writes for the wrappers), and the exports the texts were rendered from.

Examples

package_path <- tempfile("rzig-render-", tmpdir = tempdir())
dir.create(package_path)
writeLines(c("Package: examplepkg", "Version: 0.0.1"),
  file.path(package_path, "DESCRIPTION"))
use_rzig(package_path)
#> Generated RZig bindings for examplepkg: 1 exported function
#> Created RZig scaffold for package examplepkg
bindings <- render_bindings(scan_exports(package_path))
cat(bindings$wrappers)
#> # Generated by rzig::document(). Do not edit.
#> 
#> #' Return a friendly greeting.
#> #' @param name A name to greet.
#> #' @return A character string.
#> #' @examples
#> #' hello_zig("R")
#> #'
#> #' @export
#> hello_zig <- function(name) {
#>   .Call(hello_zig_, name)
#> }
cat(bindings$namespace)
#> # Generated by rzig::document(): begin
#> useDynLib("examplepkg",
#>   hello_zig_ = "hello_zig"
#> )
#> export("hello_zig")
#> # Generated by rzig::document(): end
unlink(package_path, recursive = TRUE)
